Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as either a green or blue card with [Dramon] in its name or a card with [Examon] in its name is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include a green or blue card with [Dramon] in its name or a card with [Examon] in its name, can I still add a card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect reads “Add [...] to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a green or blue card with [Dramon] in its name and a card with [Examon] in its name are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 green or blue card with [Dramon] in its name and 1 card with [Examon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Dramon] or [Examon] in its name becomes suspended, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
